body: Decided both open questions: per-turn (ledger-faithful, matches the 'every meaningful outcome is a filed Apple' ethos) and a new 'conversation' Apple type (IDUNA's apple_type isn't enum-enforced, safe to add; also added to Back Office filter dropdown, IDUNA d2b9b6e). handleChat now calls postChatTurnApple right after ConversationStore.AppendTurn -- non-fatal, silently no-ops without IDUNA env vars. Payload construction split into a pure buildChatTurnApple function (same pattern as buildCycleApple) for unit-testability without a mock server. 5 new tests, full suite green. EMILY b76f254.
title: Wired /chat to the Apple ledger (S148-00)
